subject: The one thing 90% of users skip (big mistake)
preview_text: Most people open the app and go straight to the picks. They're missing the secret sauce. Here's what you need to see.
body_paragraphs: I need to confess something. When we first built Predictify, we thought everyone would use the best part. We were wrong. Turns out, nearly all users download it, get a prediction, and close it. They're leaving the most valuable insight on the table.

It's the difference between a good tip and a winning strategy. The AI doesn't just spit out a horse name. It builds a case. It shows you *why* that pick is strong, down to the jockey's wet-track form or the trainer's history at that exact distance. Skipping this is like betting blind.

Open any race. Before you even look at the 'Predicted Winner,' scroll down. You'll see the 'Confidence Deep Dive.' This is where the magic is. It breaks down the AI's score into factors like speed rating advantage and handicap weight. This is how the sharpest punters find value everyone else misses.

Open the app right now. Pick a race today and tap into that Deep Dive. See the data behind the pick. Feel what it's like to bet with total clarity. P.S. The users who check this feature? Their win rate is significantly higher. Don't be the 90%.
cta_text: Open Predictify & See The Deep Dive
